summary: Join our Social Protection Training Course to learn about innovative savings programs. Equip yourself with essential skills for financial stability and growth!
lede: Training in savings programs and social protection helps policy advisers, program managers, and social insurance specialists assess coverage and improve benefit delivery. Participants map beneficiaries and delivery partners, analyse coverage and adequacy, compare financing scenarios, and develop payment, grievance, and monitoring workflows. The course is intended for professionals working in policy, savings, social insurance, or social protection operations who need to turn diagnostic findings into an implementation roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who already work with public policy, employee benefits, financial inclusion, household resilience, or social protection operations and need stronger design and implementation discipline.
modules: Social Protection Systems and Savings Roles
prerequisites: You should have working experience in social protection, savings programmes, social insurance, financial inclusion, public policy, employee benefits, monitoring and evaluation, or related programme operations. No coding or advanced actuarial mathematics is required. Basic spreadsheet literacy and familiarity with programme data are recommended. Power BI exercises use a guided template, so participants do not need prior Power BI experience or software development skills.
